description: Look up the name, symbol, decimals and total supply of an ERC-20 token contract on Arbitrum One, live from the contract. Use to identify an unknown token address or to format raw amounts; for a holder's balance use arb_token_balance. Input is the token's 0x contract address; an address that is not an ERC-20 contract returns 422, uncharged. Example: token=0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: arb_token_info
title: Arbitrum One ERC-20 token info
